## Downloading data from GEE

### One year

```{.javascript}
var aoi = ee.FeatureCollection("projects/ee-vernier/assets/caribou_aoi").geometry();
//var aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-125, 48, -120, 51]); 

// Define the year of interest.
var year = 2021;

// Define the start and end dates for the year.
var startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1);
var endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31);

// Import the MODIS MOD17A2H GPP product.
var gppCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD17A2HGF')
  .filterDate(startDate, endDate)
  .filterBounds(aoi) // Filter to the AOI
  .select('Gpp'); // Select the GPP band

// Function to convert GPP from kg C/m^2/8-days to kg C/m^2/year
var calculateAnnualGPP = function(image) {
  return image.multiply(365.25/8).copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']);
};

// Map the conversion function over the ImageCollection.
var annualGPPCollection = gppCollection.map(calculateAnnualGPP);
print("Number of images:", annualGPPCollection.size());

// Calculate the mean annual GPP.
var meanAnnualGPP = annualGPPCollection.mean().clip(aoi);
//var meanAnnualGPP = gppCollection.mean().clip(aoi);

// Define visualization parameters for GPP.  Adjust min/max as needed.
var gppVis = {
  min: 0,
  max: 20000,
  palette: ['bbe029', '0a9501', '074b03'],
};

// Display the mean annual GPP.
Map.addLayer(meanAnnualGPP, gppVis, 'Mean Annual GPP ' + year);
Map.centerObject(aoi, 6); // Center the map on the AOI. Adjust zoom level (7).

/*
Export.image.toDrive({
  image: meanAnnualGPP,
  folder: 'gee_data',
  description: 'Canada_Mean_Annual_GPP_' + year,
  scale: 500,
  region: aoi,
  maxPixels: 1e13 // Important for larger areas
});
*/
```

### Multi year

```{.javascript}
// Define area of interest.
var aoi = ee.FeatureCollection("projects/ee-vernier/assets/Canada_WGS84").geometry();
//var aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-125, 48, -120, 51]); 

// Define the years of interest.
var startYear = 2000;
var endYear = 2024;

// Create a list of years for iteration.
var years = ee.List.sequence(startYear, endYear);

// Function to calculate mean annual GPP for a single year.
var calculateMeanAnnualGPP = function(year) {
  var startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1);
  var endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31);

  var gppCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD17A2HGF')
    .filterDate(startDate, endDate)
    .filterBounds(aoi)
    .select('Gpp');

  // Function to convert GPP from kg C/m^2/8-days to kg C/m^2/year
  var calculateAnnualGPP = function(image) {
    return image.multiply(365.25 / 8).copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']);
  };

  // Map the conversion function over the ImageCollection.
  var annualGPPCollection = gppCollection.map(calculateAnnualGPP);

  // This combines the above two code segments
  //var annualGPPCollection = gppCollection.map(function(image) {
  //  return image.multiply(365.25 / 8).copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']);
  //});

  return annualGPPCollection.mean();
};

// Map the function over the list of years.
var annualGPPImages = years.map(calculateMeanAnnualGPP);
print('Number of GPP images:', annualGPPImages);

// Convert the List of Images to an ImageCollection.
var annualGPPCollection = ee.ImageCollection(annualGPPImages);
print('Number of annual GPP images:', annualGPPCollection);

// Calculate the overall mean GPP across all years.
var overallMeanGPP = annualGPPCollection.mean().clip(aoi);
print('Overall Mean GPP Image Info:', overallMeanGPP);

// Define visualization parameters. Adjust min/max as needed.
var gppVis = {
  min: 0,
  max: 20000,  // Example max, adjust based on your data.
  palette: ['bbe029', '0a9501', '074b03']
};

// Display the overall mean annual GPP.
Map.addLayer(overallMeanGPP, gppVis, 'Overall Mean Annual GPP ' + startYear + '-' + endYear);
Map.centerObject(aoi, 7); // Center the map. Adjust zoom level.

// Optional: Export the image.
Export.image.toDrive({
  image: overallMeanGPP,
  folder: 'gee_data',
  description: 'Canada_Mean_Annual_GPP_' + startYear + '_' + endYear,
  scale: 500, // Adjust scale as needed (meters).
  region: aoi,
  maxPixels: 1e13  // Important for larger areas!
});
```
